items.q: Right, he was a great bass player. You know, in '48 when Duke went to Europe, he didn't take the whole band, see, so I used to go up to the Apollo Bar

ctx.x: body and here he comes up on the elevator with this quart of gin and he gets off and he walks in this club and the maitre'd says sir, may I do something for you. He says no everything is cool. I just want to take this up to Milt Hinton and the maitre'd is trying to tell him that he should come up through the service entrance and he just walks right straight through the club and walks up to the bandstand and sits his quart of gin down on the bandstand with all the customers dancing and Cab Calloway looks at me,…
That was the kind of beautiful human being that Junior Ragland Ragland was, besides being a truly great bass player.
